recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if future build QA shows tx.fhir.org no longer expands the M49 region filter, or if a separate HTA/terminology-system governance issue asks to change the external code-system representation.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive DSTU1 issue reported that the 2015May ValueSet/use-context publication page could not be expanded because the publication tooling/server could not support the external M49 code system http://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49.htm. The Jira resolution was to support this code system in the build tools, and the applied comment clarified that the fix was in the server rather than source build tooling.
initial_application: No source commit tagged FHIR-6907 was found. The relevant ValueSet source already contained the M49 include before the Jira was filed, introduced by git 8ec1d99 as part of the useContext work. Later source history preserved and refined the ValueSet, so the Jira application appears to have been the terminology server fix recorded in Jira rather than a FHIR source patch.
additional_context: The current source/terminologies/valueset-use-context.xml still includes the M49 system filtered to class = region, and source/terminologies/bindings.xml still binds ConformanceUseContext to valueset-use-context. A later related Jira, FHIR-5575, mentioned ValueSet/use-context and the same M49 URI as a possible terminology-system listing concern but was resolved No Change. Current tx.fhir.org evidence finds the M49 CodeSystem as x-areas and expands the region filter to 29 M49 region codes; expanding the current use-context ValueSet also returns M49 entries. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-6907 or use-context/M49 discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR source edit is needed because the current source retains the intended external M49 reference and the server support requested by the issue is present.

related_jiras.note: A later Vocab no-change issue mentioned ValueSet/use-context and the M49 URI as a possible terminology-system listing concern, but it did not require changing this ValueSet.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ValueSet issue reporting that ValueSet/use-context could not be expanded because the M49 code system was unsupported.
evidence_items.learned: The accepted action was to support the external code system, and Jira records that the applied fix was in the server rather than source build tools.

evidence_items.summary: Current source includes the M49 URI filtered to region in ValueSet/use-context, and the terminology binding spreadsheet references valueset-use-context for ConformanceUseContext.
evidence_items.learned: The current source still carries the intended ValueSet definition, so there is no missing source hunk for FHIR-6907.

evidence_items.summary: The original use-context ValueSet was introduced with the M49 include before FHIR-6907, and no FHIR-6907-tagged source commit was found.
evidence_items.learned: History supports treating the issue as a server-side application rather than an unapplied source edit.
